conflict: Approaching the steep slopes of Mount Doom, Samwise Gamgee discovers they have run out of water and nearly out of bread, realizing they will not have enough supplies for a return journey. Frodo Baggins accepts that this is a one-way mission, while Sam refuses to give up hope of surviving.

relationships.description: Deeply bonded companions facing a hopeless trek; Frodo is resigned to sacrifice, while Sam clings to hope to keep them both moving.
